title: Customer Churn Prediction
shortDescription: ML model predicting customer churn with 89% accuracy using ensemble methods
description: Built a production-ready customer churn prediction system that analyzes customer behavior patterns to identify at-risk customers. The model processes historical transaction data, engagement metrics, and demographic information to predict churn probability.
problemStatement: Telecom companies lose billions annually due to customer churn. Identifying at-risk customers early enables targeted retention strategies.
methodology: Implemented a two-stage ensemble approach combining Random Forest and Gradient Boosting. Features were engineered from customer interaction data, usage patterns, and support tickets. Used SMOTE for handling class imbalance.
results: Achieved 89% accuracy and 84% recall on test set
Reduced false negatives by 23% compared to baseline
Model deployed to production serving 1000+ predictions/day
Contributed to 15% reduction in churn rate

title: Medical Image Classification
shortDescription: Deep learning model for classifying medical images with 94% accuracy
description: Developed a convolutional neural network for classifying medical images across 5 disease categories. The model uses transfer learning with ResNet50 and achieves high accuracy while being optimized for inference speed.
problemStatement: Manual classification of medical images is time-consuming and prone to human error. An automated system can assist radiologists in faster, more accurate diagnosis.
methodology: Fine-tuned ResNet50 on a dataset of 50,000 medical images. Applied data augmentation, class weighting, and implemented attention mechanisms for interpretability. Used mixed-precision training for efficiency.
results: Inference time of 45ms per image on CPU
Model integrated into hospital diagnostic workflow

title: Energy Demand Forecasting
shortDescription: Time series model for predicting energy demand with LSTM networks
description: Created a time series forecasting system that predicts energy demand 24 hours ahead using LSTM neural networks. The model incorporates weather data, historical usage patterns, and calendar features.
problemStatement: Accurate energy demand forecasting is crucial for grid stability and cost optimization. A 24-hour forecast enables better resource allocation and prevents outages.
methodology: Built a multi-variate LSTM model with attention mechanism. Features include historical demand, temperature, humidity, day of week, holidays, and special events. Used sliding window approach for training.
results: RMSE of 12.3 MW on test set
Successfully predicts demand spikes with 87% accuracy
Deployed to production, generating forecasts every hour

title: Real-time Sentiment Analysis
shortDescription: NLP pipeline for analyzing customer feedback sentiment at scale
description: Built a real-time sentiment analysis system processing customer reviews and social media mentions. Uses transformer-based models for nuanced sentiment detection across multiple languages.
problemStatement: Companies receive thousands of customer reviews daily. Manual analysis is impossible at scale. Automated sentiment analysis enables quick response to customer concerns.
methodology: Fine-tuned DistilBERT on domain-specific data. Implemented batch processing for high throughput. Built multi-language support using multilingual models. Deployed with Kafka for stream processing.
results: Processing throughput of 1000 texts per second
Support for 5 languages with minimal accuracy drop
